name: openai-to-azure-openai-transformer
description: Routes OpenAI Chat Completions requests to an Azure OpenAI upstream by rewriting the request path with the deployment id and api-version query parameter. The request body passes through unchanged, since Azure OpenAI is wire-compatible with the OpenAI Chat Completions API. Supports both routed (multi-provider) and unconditional (single-provider) execution modes.
